case.name: Rehum

A.name: Rehum
A.line: supervised the Levites' repairs to the wall (NEH 3:17)
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:25)
family: of-tribe levites (Levites, the tribe descended from Levi, Jacob's third son, set apart )

kjv.NEH 3:17: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

B.name: Rehum
B.line: Chief of the people who sealed Nehemiah's covenant

first_reader_said: NEH 10:25: A's notes already place Rehum on the sealed document at 10:25, and B is that same sealer with nothing added.

why: NEH 3:17 identifies A as Rehum son of Bani, a Levite. NEH 10:25 names Rehum among the chiefs of the people, whose list begins at NEH 10:14, separately from the Levites in NEH 10:9–13. This distinction supports two men; A's assignment of NEH 10:25 belongs to B.
